Traffic Advisory: Parking Restrictions on MacEwen Road Near Local Schools 🚗⚠️

The City of Summerside is advising residents and motorists of new parking restrictions on MacEwen Road, in the vicinity of Three Oaks Senior High and Athena School. 

Street parking on both sides of this section of MacEwen Road has been identified as a safety concern.

To enhance student and pedestrian safety, both sides of MacEwen Road near these schools are now designated as No Parking Zones.

Motorists are reminded that ample parking is available on the school grounds of both Three Oaks Senior High and Athena School, especially during sporting events and other school-related activities.
 
#Summerside

[3:46PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic descending from CMS bridge towards Offin Canal is experiencing slow movement due to market activities and a high volume of traffic. However, immediately after the Offin Canal, movement towards Eko Bridge by Nepa is reported to be good.

 Vehicular movement on Eko Bridge by Nepa, heading inward towards CMS Bridge, is also flowing smoothly. Descending Eko Bridge inward towards Elegbeta Mini Stadium and the Ebute-Ero market is currently experiencing good traffic conditions.

 Furthermore, traffic descending from Carter Bridge inward the Ebute-Ero market and Leventis, through the UBA roundabout connecting both the inner and outer Marina, is also moving well. A slower pace of movement is noted on Broad Street, stretching to Apongbon underneath the bridge and connecting to the Offin Canal market. 

No significant impediments beyond these conditions have been reported at this time, and personnel are on-site managing the traffic flow.

#FollowLASTMA

Recurring problem na ito mula noon hanggang ngayon.  Ang kailangan dito ay isang Sustainable Storm Water Management Program na kung saan titingnan ng pangkalahatan ang problema sa pagbaha.

1. Interconnectivity ng waterways.
2. Paglilinis at pagpapalawak ng mga estero.
3. Total ban on single-use plastics in Metro Manila.
4. Replacing concrete road pavements with porous pavement so that it can absorb rainwater.
5. Construction of a water reservoir to catch and store flood waters and convert them into water that can be repurposed.
6. Implementation of the Law on Rainwater Catchment.
7. Full accounting of all flood control projects and assessment of their effectiveness.
